messages:
Maya: FYI — over the last two weekends we had a ~38% increase in leads stuck in enrichment and not hitting owner assignment. noticed this morning, number of unassigned leads: 47. @Priya can you pull the workflow runbook? :eyes:
Priya: Yep pulling. I think it's the enrichment TTL we're using (30s) + HubSpot webhook retries causing duplicates and then RR failing.
Leadbot: alert — 47 unassigned leads created between 2026-03-20 00:00 UTC and 2026-03-22 06:00 UTC. Top source: webinar_signup.
Liam: Is this the same race we saw in feb? If enrichment service is slow, RR times out and marks lead unclaimed?
Ethan: Not marking unclaimed, it falls back to manual queue — which isn't monitored on weekends. we should avoid that. propose: extend enrichment TTL to 90s for webinar leads and add weekend override to assign to overflow SDR pool.
Priya: Agreed. quick config I can push to HubSpot workflows:
Priya: ```
# HubSpot workflow pseudo
IF lead.source == "webinar_signup" AND enrichment.completed == false AND age_seconds >= 90
  SET owner = "overflow-sdr-geo-EMEA"
  ADD note = "auto-assigned due to enrichment timeout (weekend override)"
END
``` 
Nora: Love that. Also add a Salesforce assignment rule mirror for private deployments (so we don't double-assign when SFDC sync runs):
Nora: ```
// SF assignment rule (pseudo)
Rule 103: If Origin = Webinar and EnrichmentFlag != Complete and Weekend = true then Owner = Overflow_SDR
``` 
Maya: Can we do a canary for next weekend? push to canary workspace Friday 18:00 UTC, monitor owner pickup within 2h, revert if >5% fail.
Liam: I'll own monitoring. set alert if >10 unclaimed >120m. I'll add to my dashboard.
Ethan: Also add a short email to SDRs about the temporary weekend assign behavior so they don't freak out. maybe a Slackbot post in #sales.
Priya: Implementation plan: 1) Update HS workflow draft 2) Mirror SF rule 3) Canary deploy to staging 4) Weekend canary 5) Postmortem if anomalies.
Maya: @Priya can you drop the HS workflow JSON in the playbook doc and ping #sales? I'll write the one-paragraph comms.
Priya: Will do. ETA EOD today. :white_check_mark:
Leadbot: note — scheduled canary deploy on 2026-03-27 18:00 UTC tagged weekend-handshake-canary
Ethan: tiny followup — let's also log enrichment latency per lead (new property) so we can later tune TTLs instead of guessing.
Priya: added to tasks: create property enrichment_latency_ms and populate via enrichment service. priority medium.
Maya: OK great. next check-in Monday 09:00 PT. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
